title: Signed CellComplex: ℤ-valued sign with interior-door cancellation

problemStatement.formal: Generalize the abstract \textsf{SpernerAbstract.CellComplex} framework to signed cell complexes (oriented chains). Adjacent facets carry opposite \(\pm 1\) signs with the coherence \(\mathrm{sign}(s,k) + \mathrm{sign}(s',k') = 0\). Prove the signed analog of \textsf{interior\_doors\_even}: \(\sum_{(s,k)\ \mathrm{interior\ door}} \mathrm{sign}(s,k) = 0\) in \(\mathbb{Z}\).
problemStatement.plain: Define a signed cell complex: enrich each abstract CellComplex with per-facet ±1 sign field, with adjacent facets summing to 0. Prove that the sum of facet signs over interior doors vanishes in ℤ.
whyMatters: Provides the structural substrate for orientation-aware combinatorial topology: Tucker's lemma (ℤ/2-equivariant Sperner) and Borsuk-Ulam are the canonical downstream consumers.
The ZMod-2 vs ℤ vacuity diagnosis is itself instructive: it shows that the choice of ground ring is load-bearing for orientation tracking, not a cosmetic detail.
Bridges the abstract CellComplex API to Mathlib's chain-complex framework (AlternatingFaceMapComplex over ModuleCat ℤ) as a candidate Mathlib contribution.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: SignedCellComplex structure + signed_interior_doors_sum_zero theorem in 200 LOC with 0 axioms and 0 sorries. The S1 OBSERVE's ZMod-2 vacuity diagnosed and resolved by moving to ℤ-valued signs (sign_adj : sum = 0); discharge via Finset.sum_involution applied to signedAdjMap with the four obligations mirroring the parent's interior_doors_even structure.
insights: ZMod 2 is the wrong ground ring for orientation tracking: ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two collapses opposite signs to identical signs, so 'sum = 1' coherence reduces to a Bool-valued differs-on-adjacency labeling without orientation information.
The right coherence in ℤ is sign(s,k) + sign(s',k') = 0 (genuinely negatives), which is the additive form Finset.sum_involution needs directly.
Finset.sum_involution (additive form via @[to_additive] from prod_involution) takes a dependent involution g : ∀ a ∈ s, ι; wrap signedAdjMap as fun p _hp => signedAdjMap K p to fit.

The parent's interior_doors_even proof structure reuses verbatim for the signed cancellation, with the four obligations dispatched in the same case structure: cancel via sign_adj, fpf via adj_ne, gmem via door_transfer + adj_symm, invol via adj_symm.
The parent's door_transfer lemma is private, but re-proving a one-dir variant from the public adj_vertices axiom is only ~8 LOC — no parent surgery required.
